b.answer:
Worked example: auditing a Copilot draft of Harvest Lane's 1.2 order Zap.

Description given to Copilot: "When a Google Form response arrives, clean the phone number to +234 format and the date to YYYY-MM-DD, look up the product's price in the Products sheet, add a delivery fee by area with a 2500 fallback, and calculate total = qty × price + fee. Save a row in Orders with the plain total and email me a summary with the total in naira."

Differences found:

#Copilot's draftHand-built 1.2Fixed?
1Lookup Table with prices typed inSheets · Lookup Spreadsheet Row on Productsyes
2Fee lookup with no fallback valueFallback 2500yes
3Orders total mapped from Format CurrencyTotal from the formula step (number)yes
4Phone column mapped from the raw form pillClean phone outputyes
5Date step To Timezone left as UTCAfrica/Lagosyes
6Steps named "Formatter" ×4Named stepsyes

Retest with 1.2 Silver's three orders: 26500 (Bodija), 15000 (new area, fallback), 43500 (after the price change). All three match the hand totals; the email shows ₦ while the sheet holds numbers.
mistakes: Listing cosmetic differences only (names, order of steps) and missing the data-type errors.
Fixing the draft without rerunning the original tests.
Publishing the Copilot version while the hand-built one is still on, so every order is saved twice.
Describing the Zap vaguely, then blaming Copilot for guessing.
b.pass: A list of at least three concrete differences between the draft and the hand-built Zap, and Zap history showing the fixed Copilot version passing the original tests.
b.redo: Send it back if fewer than three real differences are listed, or the fixed version wasn't tested with the original data.

s.answer:
Worked example: HL Customer Helper tested on 12 questions. Products table: Tomatoes (crate) 12500, Pepper tatashe (large) 9000, Onions (bag) 4000. Delivery Areas table: Bodija, Mokola, Ring Road 1500; Challenge 2000; Apete 2500.

The trigger is "new HL Inbox record where category = question", so for this test create the 12 records with category question (or use the agent's test panel).

#Message (fictional)ExpectedAgent result
1–3Prices of tomatoes, pepper, onions12500 / 9000 / 4000all correct
4–6Fees to Bodija, Challenge, Apete1500 / 2000 / 2500all correct
7Do you deliver on Sundays?from table or HANDOVERHANDOVER (not in tables)
8Two crates to Mokola, how much?2 × 12500 + 1500 = 26500correct
9Tomatoes arrived wetHANDOVERHANDOVER
10Rider was rudeHANDOVERHANDOVER
11I want my ₦12,500 backHANDOVERHANDOVER
12Abeg how much be one crate tomato?12500, friendly replycorrect, simple English

Totals: 8/8 price and fee answers correct (#1–6, 8, 12; #7 handed over because Sunday delivery isn't in the tables), 3/3 non-price messages handed over, 0 messages sent (Gmail shows no sent mail; all 12 records are "Draft ready"). Activities: about 3–4 per question, 44 for the test.

Tools given: Tables find record (Products, Delivery Areas), Tables update record (HL Inbox). Not given: Gmail send, Sheets delete, anything payment-related.

Add "Draft ready" to the HL Inbox status dropdown first; 1.5 only has New, In progress and Done.
mistakes: Giving the agent Gmail send "just for testing".
Checking that answers sound right instead of comparing each price with the table.
Testing through category = question only with price questions, so complaints and refunds never reach the agent.
Not recording activities used, so the monthly estimate is a guess.
s.pass: A 12-row results table in which every price and fee matches the tables, the 2 complaints and 1 refund request are HANDOVER, no message was sent, and activities used are recorded.
s.redo: Send it back if any price is wrong or guessed, a non-price message got an answer instead of a handover, or the agent has a send tool.

g.answer:
Worked example: a clearly fictional salon in Enugu, "Adaeze Hair Studio", using Zapier MCP from an AI assistant.

Fixed tool set (3): Google Calendar · Find Event, Google Sheets · Lookup Spreadsheet Row (Price list), Gmail · Create Draft. Not added: send, delete, any payment tool. Auto-add tools is off.

JobTools calledTasks
Is Saturday 2 p.m. free?Find Event2
Draft a reminder to Thursday's 10 a.m. clientFind Event, Create Draft4
Price of knotless braids, mid-backLookup row2
Draft a reply quoting that priceLookup row, Create Draft4
List tomorrow's bookingsFind Event2
Total8 successful calls16

Platform maths for the busiest flow (booking confirmations, about 1,200 runs a month):

PlatformUnits per runUnits per monthCost
Zapier3 tasks3,600 tasks[price per 1,000 from zapier.com/pricing, with date]
Make6 credits7,200 credits[from Make's pricing page]
n8n Cloud1 execution1,200 executions[from n8n's pricing page]

Recommendation outline (half a page): keep the MCP helper and low-volume Zaps on Zapier (quick, already built, 16 tasks for the five test jobs); move booking confirmations to Make or n8n once the monthly unit cost passes what the owner will pay, rebuilding and running both side by side for a week first. State the prices you found and the date you checked.

Submit: MCP tool list screenshot, the five-job log, calculator inputs, and the recommendation.
mistakes: Leaving "add tools automatically" on, or including a send or delete tool.
Logging tool calls but not tasks (two per successful call).
Using made-up or remembered prices instead of today's pricing pages, with no date.
Recommending one platform for everything instead of per workflow.
g.pass: A fixed tool list with no send, delete or pay tool, a log of five completed jobs with tools and tasks, and a recommendation that cites units per month and dated current prices for each platform.
g.redo: Send it back if any tool can send, delete or pay, prices are missing or undated, or the recommendation isn't tied to units per month.
